name: swapy
blurb: Drag-and-drop layout system with reorderable items in customizable slots.
description: A set of components wrapping the Swapy library to create draggable dashboard layouts. Includes SwapyLayout container, DragHandle icon, SwapySlot targets, and SwapyItem draggables with configurable animations.
use_when: Building dashboard layouts, widget grids, or any interface where users need to reorder content by dragging.
avoid_when: Simple lists or tables — this adds complexity for reordering.
a11y: Uses data attributes for DOM coupling; no explicit keyboard navigation for drag-drop. Focus management depends on wrapped children.
